cycleId.description: Technically optional in the schema, but application/usecase/listing.CreateListing never creates a listing without one — see ADR-0001.

photos.description: Object storage keys — signed URLs are generated on demand via infrastructure/objectstorage, never stored.

flagged.description: Set by application/usecase/report.CreateReport once the repeated-report threshold trips; hides the listing from the public marketplace until an admin resolves it.
